note: End-to-end skeleton stood up by hand: real mesh slicing with generated cut faces, procedural fruit materials, GPU-analytic juice, blade ribbon, ballistic director, slow-mo reward, procedural audio, adaptive quality tiers, and a deterministic virtual-clock screenshot harness. Two real bugs found and fixed during bring-up: a negative first-frame delta permanently poisoning the fixed-step accumulator, and an uninitialised particle ring-buffer head that silently discarded every juice emission. Scores below are my own honest read against the bar, before any critic has looked.

pieces.name: Lighting & grade
pieces.biggestGap: Background reads navy-grey with visible dust, not the plate's pure black; key light is soft where the plate is hard.

pieces.name: Fruit materials
pieces.biggestGap: Cut faces are flat saturated lozenges — no seeds, pith band, fibre or wet sheen resolve at all.

pieces.name: Fruit silhouette
pieces.biggestGap: Faceting is visible on the sphere; shapes read as deformed balls rather than specific fruit.

pieces.name: Cut faces
pieces.biggestGap: Rind thickness at the cut edge is nearly invisible, so the silhouette reads paper-thin.

pieces.name: Juice fluid
pieces.biggestGap: Juice reads as a spray of red streaks — no coherent sheet, which is the plate's defining feature.

pieces.name: Blade & trail
pieces.biggestGap: Trail blows out into a featureless white blob under bloom.

pieces.name: Slice mechanics
pieces.biggestGap: Halves separate as pure translation; the reference is dominated by rotation about the cut.

pieces.name: Pacing & levels
pieces.biggestGap: Untuned — arcs and wave composition have never been judged against a play capture.

pieces.name: HUD & progression
pieces.biggestGap: Unverified against a real screenshot at phone aspect.
